director_input.summary: The Director stated that the exemplar situations and contextual distinctions were confusing in detail, but explicitly trusted Design Sol's judgment on this task because Design Sol had a clear vision for distinguishing contexts and preserving the user experience.
director_input.authority_effect: The Director delegated resolution of this frozen use-envelope gate to Design Sol's already-frozen recommendation. This is not represented as independent Director scoring of each exemplar.
director_input.prior_relevant_preference: The Director previously selected CS2 for its easy-on-the-eyes, low-micro-twitch-fatigue, gentle mysterious / slightly magical quality.

approved_law.CS2: Balanced Crossfade Exchange is the provisional shared-brand treatment for eligible already-ready genuine context replacement only.
approved_law.F1A: F1A Tight remains the provisional bounded within-context succession treatment; F1A and CS2 must not explain the same transition event.
approved_law.CUT: CUT is a first-class outcome whenever incoming content is not ready, overlap becomes visually fatiguing, semantics are not replacement, motion is reduced, a transition is interrupted/retargeted, host geometry materially changes, directional/history semantics are required, or interaction/focus truth cannot remain correct.
approved_law.semantic_truth: Incoming semantic and interaction ownership is authoritative independently of the visual fade and commits at transition start for eligible CS2; animation never delays or overrides state truth.

why: A1 best preserves CS2's calm and slightly magical context-boundary character.
A2 and A3 remain truthful but should be scarce enough that CS2 retains identity value rather than becoming generic decoration.
N1 is semantically dangerous because a pleasant fade can disguise unavailable/loading content as meaningful transformation.
N2 turns softness into competing letterforms and perceptual interference, violating the Director's low-fatigue preference.
N3 falsely describes an added overlay as replacement of the underlying context.
non_authority: 280 ms duration and comparison easing remain research fixtures, not production tokens.
No universal screen/page crossfade rule is created.
No final motion system, final identity or Phase-C convergence is created.
program_disposition: MOT-01 closes as a successful bounded shared-brand motion-independence program with provisional F1A and CS2 mechanism evidence plus explicit CUT law. Future production-token work remains separately gated.
